title: Galaxy Fight: Universal Warriors
native_title: ギャラクシー・ファイト ～ユニバーサル・ウォリアーズ～
overview:
Man longs for gods, and heaven sends down demons.

A hyper battle action game of fierce fights staged across eight planets.

Once every thousand years a god takes form in the galaxy, and this time it is Felden, a god of evil who means to rule over every world. Pick one of eight fighters, including Rolf, Kazuma, Juri, Roomi, Gunter, Alvan, Musafar and G. Done, and travel from planet to planet to defeat every challenger.

Battles are 2D one-on-one bouts fought over the best of three timed rounds. Stages scroll endlessly in both directions, so there are no corners to trap anyone in. Light, medium and heavy attacks change depending on distance and stance, and dashing in adds extra power to your hits.

- Story mode with character dialogue before and after each fight
- Two-player versus mode
- Five difficulty levels
- Special moves can be assigned to buttons

人、神を望み、天、悪魔を降らす。

8つの惑星を舞台に、熱い闘いを繰り広げるハイパーバトルアクション。
